findings.finding: Driver normal COD fare is retained in cash; do not create a second withdrawal entitlement.
Verified exception fare can credit driver AVAILABLE; credit is not yet a complete disbursement workflow.
Cancellation compensation execution credits driver wallet; source journal and case must remain linked.
Topup adds available collateral funds; existing availableBalance does not prove unrestricted withdrawal.
Ledger rules classify AVAILABLE/LOCKED movements, not remaining withdrawable provenance.
Driver model exposes available and locked, not an authoritative withdrawable balance.

implementationRequired: Versioned disbursement policy and explicit eligible source rules; no automatic AVAILABLE=WITHDRAWABLE conversion
Verified source references and consumed/pending allocation so spending or concurrent holds cannot duplicate entitlement
Authenticated driver request and staff review with limits; server-derived amounts and destination
Atomic payout reservation distinct from order collateral, with idempotency and version fences
Separate approval, execution and driver receipt states; no PAID on mere approval
Cashbox/source accounting or verified transfer evidence according to selected method
Documented failure release and reconciliation; uncertain external payment never auto-retried as a new payout
Driver wallet and admin UI with status, source amount, reference and receipt; monthly statement supports payout effects
notImplementedClaims: No driver payout endpoint or payable balance was added by this audit
No paid wallet movements or provider operations were executed
Merchant payout cannot be relabelled as driver payout without independent owner and accounting checks
requiredTests: No second payment for retained COD cash
No withdrawal of order collateral or disputed/unknown-source funds
Approval without physical payment is not PAID
Execution failure versus uncertain execution reconciliation
Single driver confirmation and immutable journal
Statement and wallet reconciliation after payment and release
